question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ______ of this beautiful garden is so exciting.
solution: The correct answer is **option (4)** i.e. **'sight'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence indicates the beauty of a garden. • **Sight:** (दृश्य) It refers to something that is seen or the act of seeing. • **Example:** The mountain range was a breathtaking **sight**. • Hence, **'sight'** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. *Therefore, the correct answer is 'sight'.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** • **Site: **(स्थल) It refers to a location or place. • **Example: **They chose a beautiful site for their picnic. • **Slight: **(सूक्ष्म) It means small in degree or extent. • **Example:** She noticed a slight change in his attitude. • **Cite**: (उद्धरण देना) It means to quote or mention as evidence or an example. • **Example**: He will cite several sources in his research paper. 3a:T9cd,
